title: Private Provenance and Source Registry Import
negative_results: Private data loads only via cwatlas.privacy (ignored CWATLAS_PRIVATE_DIR); absent the env var the adapter yields an empty import.
A record's narrative field (narrative/notes/label/prediction) is never exported; public projections carry only opaque id, raw_hash, tokens, body status/use.
The raw source string is never exported (assert_exportable refuses if 'raw' would appear).
A PRIVATE-tagged record refuses public export outright (privacy.PrivacyError).
The Stonehenge training anchor is referenced by the opaque id STONEHENGE_PRIVATE_001 only; neither 'Stonehenge' nor 165876523 appears in any projection.
Vectors register with body status UNKNOWN unless a body is explicitly assigned (unlabeled vectors are not guessed).
Provenance is typed onto the existing hash-chained cwatlas.provenance_ledger; verify_chain() holds and the ledger head is deterministic for identical synthetic inputs.

claims.statement: The communications-derived source-vector registry and its anchor records are imported as typed, hash-chained provenance without exposing any private narrative.
Public tests use synthetic vectors referenced by opaque fixture ids; no *.private.example.json is read.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic/public fixtures only, no private inputs
